Bahrain Family Residence Cost Calculator

Enter your family members and insurance premium to see the fees for the two-year cycle and the yearly cost.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Work out your family residence cost

Family residence fees in Bahrain

ItemAmount (BHD)When
Dependent residence permit90For two years, issue or renewal
Admin fee (LMRA)5Each application
Smart card10At issue
Private health insuranceInsurer's priceMandatory for new applications since 1 Sep 2026

Example: a wife and two children: permits 3 × 95 = 285 and cards 30 = BHD 315 for two years plus insurance, then about BHD 142.5 a year for renewal.

Dependent applications go through the employer's account, with a net salary of BHD 400 required, or 1,000 for parents and children over 24 through the Nationality, Passports and Residence Affairs. The mandatory insurance must cover at least the worker's permit period.

For your net pay after contributions use the Bahrain net salary calculator.

Frequently asked questions

How much is a wife's residence permit in Bahrain?

A dependent residence permit costs BHD 90 for two years, for issue or renewal, plus a BHD 5 LMRA admin fee and a BHD 10 smart card for non-Bahrainis; private health insurance is added for new dependent applications since 1 September 2026.

What salary do you need to sponsor your family in Bahrain?

BHD 400 net according to the social insurance record (it was 250 until 2021), and BHD 1,000 to sponsor parents and children over 24.

Is health insurance mandatory for dependents in Bahrain?

Yes, for new dependent applications since 1 September 2026, through a private policy covering at least the worker's permit period; no standard price is published, and it is expected to extend to renewals later.
